name: 30066 · Marietta, GA
findings: ZIP 30066 (Marietta) has 215 nonprofit organizations. 96 of them (45%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 70 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (21% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 30066 (Marietta) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
